the development of new synthetic methods for the preparation of optically active piperid-4-one derivatives and the study of the stereochemical course of reactions involving these compounds.

the reaction of chiral enamines with sodium borohydrate in the presence of a proton donor (e.g., acetic acid or trifluoroacetic acid) leads to a 1,4-addition of hydride to the carbon-carbon double bond and the formation of a new chiral center.

the reaction of chiral enamines with NaBH4 is an efficient method for the asymmetric reduction of C=O and C=N bonds.
